{{Quote|Oh, by the way, a former Imperial Navy lieutenant you had court-martialed is about to release a memoir.|Wynn Dorvan to Natasi Daala|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
A '''lieutenant''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], but was court-martialed by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the former [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] compiled a memoir entitled ''[[Into the Maw: Black Holes, Egos, and Other Forces that Devour Lives]]''. The memoir focused on Daala&mdash;who had since become the [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]&mdash;and was set to be released<ref name="Backlash" /> around [[44 ABY]],<ref>It is stated in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'' that the memoir is going to be released very soon, and ''Backlash'' takes place at the very end of [[43 ABY]], leading directly into ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', which begins in [[44 ABY]]</ref> coinciding with the time that Daala's public approval ratings began to decline. Shortly before it was released, the Chief of State's [[Aide/Legends|aide]], [[Wynn Dorvan]], learned about the ex-lieutenant's memoir and informed Daala of it.<ref name="Backlash" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial lieutenant was mentioned in [[Aaron Allston]]'s ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'', the fourth novel in the 9-part ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' series, released in [[2010]].<ref name="Backlash" />
